subject.title: Backup: add encrypted snapshot backup flow

question: Should OpenClaw core accept a native folder-backed encrypted snapshot backup flow in this PR, or should broader backup design remain centered on the existing local archive flow and tracked backup issues?
rationale: The PR adds new core CLI commands, persisted config, restore semantics, and security-sensitive filesystem behavior, which requires maintainer intent beyond a mechanical bug fix.

options.title: Fix and continue this native flow
options.body: Keep this PR open as the candidate, but require the safety fixes, conflict rebase, upgrade proof, and real behavior proof before merge.

options.title: Narrow to archive hardening only
options.body: Ask for a smaller PR that preserves useful backup export/verify hardening while deferring snapshot setup/run/restore product direction.

options.title: Close in favor of a new design issue
options.body: Close this branch if maintainers want the encrypted snapshot workflow redesigned against the broader backup roadmap before implementation.

recommendation.title: Fix and continue this native flow
recommendation.body: Keep this PR open as the candidate, but require the safety fixes, conflict rebase, upgrade proof, and real behavior proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent current-main maintenance makes vincentkoc the best available routing owner for deciding whether this large core/config PR should keep moving.
